ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer Aided Drafting and Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.

2. When learning Home- based Automatic Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Home- based Automatic Systems.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Home- based Automatic Systems.

7. When learning Single phase Alternating Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.

8. When learning Project Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project Implementation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Implementation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Implementation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Implementation.

9. When learning Solar Photovoltaic Installation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

10. When learning Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.

11. When learning Fabrication Techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fabrication Techniques.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Fabrication Techniques.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fabrication Techniques.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fabrication Techniques.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fabrication Techniques and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Direct Current Motors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Single phase Alternating Current Motors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
